detail.longDescription: I have a Python namespace package (which allows subpackages of a main package to be in separate directories on disk per PEP 240 ): main-package/ python/ mynspack/ common/ commonfunctions.py Which provides: import mynspack from mynspack import common I have other subpackages of mynspack elsewhere: other-library/ python/ mynspack/ additional/ additionalfunctions.py Which allows users to: from mynspack import additional Now if other-library is not installed, users attempting the second import will see ImportError: mynspack has no module additional . I would like it if I could do something so that in this scenario they could get a message telling them to install the second package.
